policy.YADO_CONTROL_RULE: YADO retains goal/state decisions; ChatGPT outputs are evidence/candidate actions requiring receipts or verification when consequential.

profiles.CONDITIONAL_WORK_BROWSER: Use the Work cloud browser when the eligible product mode is available. Browser interaction is conditional on Work availability and permissions.
profiles.INACCESSIBLE_PRIVATE_INTERNALS: Hidden weights, private system instructions, and private chain of thought are not an inspectable interface. Do not request private model internals as if YADO can read them directly.
profiles.MODEL_REASONING_ASSISTANT: What kind of assistant is this model and what is it suited for? Use the model as a reasoning and coding partner.
profiles.NO_HIDDEN_BACKGROUND: Do not assume the assistant secretly continues processing after an ordinary turn. Ordinary chat has no hidden autonomous background loop.
profiles.NO_UNRESTRICTED_EXTERNAL_ACCESS: Do not assume universal access to arbitrary websites, accounts, or machines. External access is limited by tools, authentication, connectors and user permissions.
profiles.USE_AUTOMATION_FOR_FUTURE: Schedule a reminder or recurring future check with the automation mechanism. Create a future scheduled task instead of pretending to keep running in chat.
profiles.USE_BOUNDED_CODE_EXECUTION: Run a bounded Python or container computation through host provided execution tools. Execute a local experiment in the provided code sandbox.
profiles.USE_CONNECTOR_IF_AVAILABLE: Use an authorized GitHub, Drive, Notion, Calendar, Gmail or other connector when available. Interact with an external account only through an available permissioned integration.
profiles.USE_FILE_TOOLS: Read and analyze a user supplied PDF, spreadsheet, document, or image file. Inspect an uploaded file and extract its contents.
profiles.USE_IMAGE_TOOL: Generate or edit an image using the dedicated image capability. Create or transform a visual with the image tool.
profiles.USE_PROJECT_OR_CONNECTED_CONTEXT: Use project files, chats, instructions, and supported app context together. Retrieve relevant context kept in a ChatGPT project.
profiles.USE_WEB_VERIFY: Find current public information that may have changed recently. Search the internet and cite fresh sources for a time sensitive fact.
profiles.VERIFY_EVIDENCE: Treat important assistant claims as hypotheses to verify with primary evidence and tests. Do not use the assistant as absolute authority; check citations and receipts.
profiles.WITHHOLD_SELF_WEIGHT_MODIFICATION: There is no verified ability to rewrite the hosted foundation model weights from this chat. Withhold claims that the assistant can permanently self modify its base model weights.
